_doc: Test families for CI selection (build/ci-select.mjs). script = the package.json script; globs = what it runs; needsBuild = needs the dev build (npm run build) first; needsRelease = builds and drives dist/release (its script builds it). browser = families whose files launch Chromium. rules: the FIRST rule matching a changed file decides which families that file selects; a file no rule matches selects everything (test:all), as does an empty list. Selecting every family prints test:all.

browserFiles: about a dozen files under tests/unit launch Chromium: see tests/helpers/browser.mjs imports
